data.name: TooltipEmbedImportedComponents
data.value: For a downloaded assembly (e.g. a STEP file) inserted through 3D Interconnect: breaks the link to the imported file, dissolves the imported subassembly and embeds its parts as virtual components of this assembly, so mates can make it move. data.name: EmbedImportedComponentsConfirmMessage
data.value:
Unsaved changes to the assembly are saved first. Then the link to the imported file is broken, which can't be undone, the imported subassembly is dissolved and its parts are embedded as virtual components of this assembly. The imported file is then checked in to PDM, since the assembly no longer references it.
The result is not saved. If it isn't right, close the assembly without saving to get back to the state saved just before.
Continue?
